Actual wrong-password submission clears only password and preserves selected driver/vehicle/odometer; correct retry starts one trip for the synthetic off-duty driver, marks available explicitly and updates setup to 4/4 and order eligibility to 1/4. No order assignment submitted.

Edited assignment close offers Keep editing/Discard changes; Keep editing retains the driver selection and Discard closes. Pending/duplicate mutation protection additionally tested with the actual shared form renderer.

Missing-trip guidance offers the admin alternative. Both Dispatch blocked-driver and Orders Details→Assign shortcuts open the vehicle dialog. Dispatch callback closes the old assignment dialog; deep-link close clears its hash.

Actual branch-manager identity opens the same scoped Lagos form with current-password confirmation. Owner and manager QA sessions signed out; Login observed, initial light theme and desktop viewport restored.

limitations: Browser breakpoints and keyboard checks, not physical/native/assistive acceptance. One trip/availability mutation occurred only in disposable local fixture. No order, stock or financial mutation.
